ăquaemănālis , e, adj. aqua - manus,
I.pertaining to water for the hand, i. e. to water for washing; hence, ăquaemă-nālis , is, m., sc urceus (cf. aqualis), a basin for washing the hands, a wash-basin, Varr. ap. Non. p 547, 9.—For which in Paul. Sent. 3, 6, ăquĭmĭnāle , is, n., v aquiminarium
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
